caption: The drawing shows five views of a cylindrical, dark green or olive-colored duffel bag with brown leather straps, handles, and buckles. The main, central image displays the bag in a horizontal position with three brown leather straps running over the top, secured by buckles, and two fabric handles positioned at the center and one end. On the upper left, the bag is illustrated in a rolled-up, compact form, secured by its straps. In the lower part of the image, two open views of the bag reveal the inside, showing the flap lifted, with corresponding strap placements for closure. The bottom right image includes a measurement line marked with “20” indicating the length of the bag. In the top right corner, there is an inset image showing a close-up detail of a strap, buckle, and attachment hardware, all in shades of brown and brass. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and in the bottom right corner, there are handwritten notations with the name “G. Saltar” and other text.
title: Rolled Leather Knapsack
